scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) - Overdraft Facility
description: Overdraft facility for PMJDY account holders.
Eligible: PMJDY account holders with satisfactory transaction history for 6 months, age 18–65 years.
Provides overdraft up to ₹10,000 (₹2,000 without conditions, ₹10,000 with conditions).
Priority to women account holders (one woman per household).
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Overdraft facility up to ₹10,000

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana - Shishu Category
description: Collateral-free loan for very small micro-enterprises.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 18–65, with non-farm income-generating activities.
Provides loan up to ₹50,000.
Priority to women, SC/ST, OBC entrepreneurs.
npa_percentage: Approx. 5.3% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Regional Rural Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹50,000 loan

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana - Kishore Category
description: Collateral-free loan for growing micro-enterprises.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 18–65, with existing micro-enterprises.
Provides loan from ₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh.
Priority to women, SC/ST, OBC entrepreneurs.
documents_required: Bank account details with 6 months statement
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: ₹50,001 to ₹5 lakh loan

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana - Tarun Category
description: Collateral-free loan for established micro-enterprises.
Eligible: Indian citizens, age 18–65, with established micro-enterprises.
Provides loan from ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh.
Priority to women, SC/ST, OBC entrepreneurs.
documents_required: Bank account details with 1 year statement
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: ₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh loan

description: Bank loans for SC/ST entrepreneurs to start first-time non-farm enterprise.
Eligible: SC/ST entrepreneurs, age 18+, first-time enterprise in manufacturing/services/trading.
At least 51% ownership must be held by SC/ST entrepreneur.
Loan from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore loan

description: Bank loans for women entrepreneurs to start first-time non-farm enterprise.
Eligible: Women entrepreneurs, age 18+, first-time enterprise in manufacturing/services/trading.
At least 51% ownership must be held by woman entrepreneur.
Loan from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore loan

description: Government subsidy for setting up new micro-enterprises.
Eligible: Any Indian citizen above 18 years, no income ceiling.
Project cost limit: ₹50 lakh (manufacturing), ₹20 lakh (services).
Subsidy: 15% (urban), 25% (rural) for general category.
documents_required: Educational certificates (minimum 8th pass for projects above ₹10 lakh)
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) or ₹20 lakh (services) with 15–25% subsidy

description: Higher government subsidy for SC/ST/OBC/women entrepreneurs.
Eligible: SC/ST/OBC/women, any Indian citizen above 18 years.
Project cost limit: ₹50 lakh (manufacturing), ₹20 lakh (services).
Subsidy: 25% (urban), 35% (rural) for special category.
documents_required: Educational certificates (minimum 8th pass for projects above ₹10 lakh)
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) or ₹20 lakh (services) with 25–35% subsidy

description: Term loan for SC entrepreneurs for income-generating activities.

npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹15 lakh term loan at concessional interest

scheme_name: VCF-SC (Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes)
description: Venture capital support for SC entrepreneurs for startups and innovative ventures.
Eligible: SC entrepreneurs with innovative business ideas, family income below ₹8 lakh/year.
Provides equity/soft loan support up to ₹30 lakh.
Implemented through SIDBI and partner institutions.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Equity/soft loan support up to ₹30 lakh

scheme_name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana
description: Loan and subsidy for youth to start new enterprises.
Eligible: UP residents, age 21–45 years, family income below ₹2 lakh/year.
Loan up to ₹10 lakh with 25% subsidy (30% for SC/ST).
Priority to women, SC/ST, OBC youth.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹10 lakh loan with 25–30% subsidy

description: Employment generation scheme for youth.
Eligible: UP domicile, age 21–45 years, family income below ₹2 lakh/year.

npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Loan up to ₹10 lakh with interest subsidy

description: Financial assistance for entrepreneurs from EBC, BC, and minority communities.

Financial assistance up to ₹10 lakh (₹5 lakh for general category within EBC/BC).
Implemented through banks with government support.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Up to ₹10 lakh financial assistance

scheme_name: Madhya Pradesh Mukhyamantri Seekho Kamao Yojana
description: Skill training with stipend for youth.
Eligible: MP domicile, age 18–29 years, minimum Class 8 pass.
Provides skill training and monthly stipend during training.
Priority to women, SC/ST, OBC youth.
channel_partner_name: District Skill Development Office + Training Centre, MP
npa_percentage: Not applicable (not a lending institution)
maximum_benefit: Free skill training + monthly stipend (₹5,000–₹10,000) during training

description: Monthly unemployment allowance for educated, jobless youth.
Eligible: Rajasthan domicile, age up to 30 years (35 for women/SC/ST/OBC/PwD), family income below ₹2 lakh/year.
Must hold at least Bachelor's degree, be registered with Employment Exchange.
Maximum 2 members per family can receive allowance simultaneously.
channel_partner_name: District Employment Exchange Office + CSC centre, Rajasthan
npa_percentage: Not applicable (not a lending institution)
maximum_benefit: Monthly unemployment allowance (₹1,000–₹3,000 per month)

scheme_name: Punjab Chief Minister's Skill Development Mission
description: Free skill training and placement support for youth.

Placement assistance after training completion.
channel_partner_name: Punjab Skill Development Mission Office, Chandigarh
npa_percentage: Not applicable (not a lending institution)
